entities.summary: Salvatore "Salvo" Andò is an Italian academic and politician who was Minister of Defence between 1992 and 1993. A leading figure of the Italian Socialist Party (PSI), he was a city councilor from 1970 to 1991, first in Giarre and then in Catania. Elected to the Chamber of Deputies for the first time in 1979, he was a member of the Italian Parliament for four legislatures. Andò was Minister of Defense in the first Amato government from June 1992 to April 1993.

entities.summary: Salvatore "Salvo" Andò is an Italian academic and politician who was Minister of Defence between 1992 and 1993. A leading figure of the Italian Socialist Party (PSI), he was a city councilor from 1970 to 1991, first in Giarre and then in Catania. Elected to the Chamber of Deputies for the first time in 1979, he was a member of the Italian Parliament for four legislatures. Andò was Minister of Defense in the first Amato government from June 1992 to April 1993.
